metaDescription: Kevin investigates Jean Phil, a viral AI-generated TikTok boxer tied to a meme coin, and argues blame belongs to humans rather than AI.
summary: Kevin investigates Jean Phil (Jean Philanthrope), an AI-generated character who gained roughly 250,000 followers in weeks and was linked to a crypto meme coin. He describes copycats such as Archibald Brown that also link to coins, and explains how pump-and-dump schemes work. Kevin notes the coin launched September 20 and, with a market cap near 10.7 million dollars, does not look like a classic pump and dump, though he says he would not buy it. He argues AI is software and that it is humans all the way down. He calls the trend dystopian and expects it to fade.

keyMoments.label: Is The Coin A Pump And Dump?
